Spin Master and Paramount Announce Fourth PAW Patrol Theatrical Film Set for 2029 Release

29 Oct 2026, 07:34 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

Expanding the Pups' Cinematic Universe

Spin Master Corp., alongside Paramount Animation and Nickelodeon Movies, has officially announced that a fourth PAW Patrol feature film is in active development. The upcoming instalment is slated for a theatrical release in 2029, with distribution handled by Paramount Pictures.

Director Cal Brunker, who helmed previous franchise entries including PAW Patrol: The Movie, PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie, PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie, and The Nut Job 2: Nutty by Nature, is returning to direct the latest film. Brunker will also co-write the screenplay alongside Bob Barlen.

Background and Franchise Performance

The announcement builds on the strong commercial and critical performance of the franchise's prior theatrical outings. According to the official announcement, the first three theatrical films grossed a combined half-billion dollars at the global box office and each achieved audience approval ratings above 93% on the Rotten Tomatoes Popcornmeter.

Originally debuting as a television series in 2013, PAW Patrol has grown into a major preschool property, broadcasting in over 190 territories across 33 languages and maintaining its position as the top preschool show on Nick Jr.

Leadership Perspectives

"PAW Patrol is a global entertainment phenomenon, and we're investing in the franchise to give fans more of what they love," said Vishnu Athreya, EVP & President of Spin Master Entertainment. He added that the company aims to further expand the universe through varied media formats, including series, specials, short-form video, and connected play.

Jennifer Dodge, President of Paramount Animation, noted the continued partnership between the studios, stating, "Together, with our partners at Spin Master, we're excited to bring audiences another adventure that's made for the theatrical experience."

Director Cal Brunker also expressed enthusiasm for the project, noting that the creative team has developed a new story designed for moviegoers.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For families and fans following the franchise, this announcement confirms long-term plans for the intellectual property on the big screen, though a specific theatrical release date beyond the year 2029 has not yet been established.

What is confirmed:

  • A fourth PAW Patrol feature film is in production by Spin Master Entertainment, Paramount Animation, and Nickelodeon Movies.
  • Paramount Pictures will distribute the film in 2029.
  • Cal Brunker will direct and co-write the film with Bob Barlen.

What remains unknown:

  • Specific plot details, character additions, and exact monthly release dates are not yet disclosed.

Readers can verify these details and review the full corporate announcement directly through the official [PR Newswire source release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/a-fourth-paw-patrol-feature-film-in-the-works-from-spin-master-entertainment-paramount-animation-and-nickelodeon-movies-302922745.html).
